mapper.select: SELECT s.*, p.title AS position_title, u.name AS student_name FROM schedules s JOIN positions p ON s.position_id = p.id JOIN users u ON s.student_id = u.id WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY s.created_at ASC

SELECT s.*, p.title AS position_title, u.name AS student_name FROM schedules s JOIN positions p ON s.position_id = p.id JOIN users u ON s.student_id = u.id WHERE s.position_id = #{positionId} ORDER BY s.week_day, s.time_slot

SELECT s.*, p.title AS position_title, u.name AS student_name FROM schedules s JOIN positions p ON s.position_id = p.id JOIN users u ON s.student_id = u.id WHERE p.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
